title_en: Premium Apartment for Sale, 3+1+2 toilets, Air Albania
description_en: Rare property on the market! Near the Air Albania Stadium, we exclusively offer a premium apartment 3+1+2 bathrooms for sale. The apartment is located in a new, well-managed building with 2 elevators, 5th floor. The apartment has a total area of 220 m2, and is organized in the living room with access to the balcony, separate kitchen, storage room/laundry, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 2 balconies. Very solid investment. quality, engineered wood flooring, chiller air conditioning system. The apartment has very good lighting, the living room together with one room are oriented south, the other 2 rooms are oriented east. Possibility of parking at an extra cost on the -1st floor. It is currently rented out. To see it up close, contact me.
